changes_made.explanation: Removed incorrectly listed tasks (Text Summarization, Dialogue Generation) and dataset (MMAUM-mini). Normalized task names to standard forms. Added explicit Speech-to-Text Translation task. Simplified output descriptions while preserving core NLG aspects.
Normalized metric names to canonical forms and removed duplicates. Kept only base metric forms (BLEU, Accuracy) as specified in guidelines.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation method found in the paper. The paper uses LLMs for data generation but not for post-generation evaluation.
No human evaluation mentioned in the paper. All evaluation appears to be conducted using automatic metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses primarily on audio reasoning with NLG components (QA, translation, emotion recognition). Extraction was mostly accurate but included some incorrect tasks and duplicate metrics. The paper's NLG evaluation relies entirely on automatic metrics without human or LLM-based assessment.
